SELECT
    multiIf(
        gap_duration_seconds < 900,  '10–15 min',
        gap_duration_seconds < 1800, '15–30 min',
        gap_duration_seconds < 3600, '30–60 min',
        '60+ min'
    ) AS gap_duration,
    count() AS gaps
FROM analytics.ais_vessel_gap_events
WHERE event_type = 'AIS_GAP_ENDED'
  AND gap_ended_at >= now('UTC') - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  AND gap_duration_seconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY gap_duration
ORDER BY
    multiIf(
        gap_duration = '10–15 min', 1,
        gap_duration = '15–30 min', 2,
        gap_duration = '30–60 min', 3,
        4
    );
